description: This PHP class defines a Result within the AWS SDK. It provides methods to access data, perform searches using JMESPath, and generate string representations of the result data.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Represents a generic AWS result object capable of data access, search, and string conversion functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Result with optional data array.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in the result data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key from the result data.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a JMESPath search expression on the result data.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON representation of the result data as a string.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Deprecated method that performs a search with path-like syntax, converted to dot notation.
